purpose: Single owner-executable route from accepted source conformance to real Wallet interoperability. This plan is a release gate, not runtime evidence.

invariants.layer1Independence: Gateway or Product Session failures may set PRIVATE_SERVICE_DEGRADED only; they cannot revoke, hide, reconnect or reopen a completed Layer 1 Standard Wallet connection.
invariants.rpcBoundary: A browser fetch to a CORS-disabled RPC endpoint is never a connection prerequisite. An accepted CORS-safe probe may be reported separately as degraded.
invariants.webTransport: Web may not navigate a custom scheme, use an iframe launcher, open a blank top-level target, or encode a handwritten authorization request. Native remains resolver-first and uses the canonical request builder.
invariants.authority: A product never fabricates an account, approval, signature, transaction, WalletConnect session or Product Session. Reject and unavailable paths retain no new authority.

ynxWallet: EIP-6963 provider info is YNX Wallet
metaMask: MetaMask is independently discovered or selected
requiredProviderIdentityProof.ambiguity: Multiple indistinguishable providers fail closed with a visible selection/error; install/download fallback is not a successful connection.

request again after DOMContentLoaded

read eth_chainId

explicit user-action personal_sign
explicit user-action eth_signTypedData_v4 with chain-bound domain

force only private Product Session/Gateway unavailable
show PRIVATE_SERVICE_DEGRADED
preserve selected provider, approved account and completed standard connection
use real configured project ID and relay
pair a first-party DApp and one external DApp
approve and reject proposals
approve only 0x account/methods/eip155:6423
restart restore
personal_sign, EIP-712 and testnet send
disconnect/revoke purges session

dappCoverage.requirement: All four DApps must be separately opened in a real browser or installed client; fixtures, provider detection and static URLs do not count.

required: owner source commit/tree and shared-source consumer gate output
public deployment URL plus exact source/version/build identity
real browser or installed-device screenshots and console output
signature request IDs, transaction hash/receipt when user approves
rollback target and observed rollback result
forbiddenSubstitutes: ComputerControl inferred from ordinary browser evidence

ownerDispatch.restriction: Card has an independent goal; Protocol Owner must not change Card source.
nextE2E: all standard lifecycle and Product Session evidence

ownerDispatch.sourceGateBlocker: Current consumer audit detects handwritten/top-level authorize paths in apps/shop/wallet-auth.js and native WalletAuth.java; remove them through the canonical public SDK before source consumption can be true.
nextE2E: remove legacy authorize paths and pass consumer audit
connected account opens details rather than chooser
consume safe launcher v2/canonical native builder

promotionRule: A product is not connected or migrated until its owner has supplied the source-consumption, source-bound-public-runtime and direct visible E2E envelope. All product rows also need the Layer 1 degradation boundary. Aggregate parity additionally requires all 12 product rows and all four DApp profiles.
